title: Siddi Tribe of Gujarat: PVTG Status, Origin and Scheduled Tribe Classification
summary: Siddi tribe of Gujarat: African origin, PVTG status, ST status in 1956 and a Youth Olympics medal hook (Nov 2026). UPSC notes.
body_markdown:
The Siddis of Saurashtra were declared a Scheduled Tribe in 1956 and were classified as a PVTG in 1982. Siddis outside Saurashtra, for example in Bharuch, are not Scheduled Tribes and fall under the Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC) (Drishti IAS, 12 Nov 2026).


**What is a PVTG?** In general terms, a PVTG is a sub-category among Scheduled Tribes. It is meant for tribal groups considered more vulnerable than other tribal groups.
